name: temporal_mnemic_dilation
label: Echo's Slowed Pulse
poeticVision: The player feels a sudden, desperate clarity as time itself unravels around them, allowing for a split-second decision in a life-or-death situation. Yet, this stolen time comes at the immediate, agonizing cost of a cherished memory fragment dissolving into shimmering dust, forcing a brutal trade-off between survival and self.

parameters.name: slow_time_scale
parameters.description: The time scale value during the slowed pulse (e.g., 0.2 means 20% normal speed).

parameters.name: slow_duration
parameters.description: How long time remains slowed before returning to normal speed.

parameters.name: time_scale_tween_speed
parameters.description: The duration (in seconds) for the time scale transition (both when slowing down and speeding up).

parameters.name: memory_fade_duration
parameters.description: The duration (in seconds) over which the sacrificed memory fragment visually degrades and fades out.

verdict: A desperate clarity bought with the very essence of self, this pulse is the agonizing echo of survival's brutal price.
impact: This mechanic profoundly deepens the player's engagement with the core theme of identity loss. Every use forces a visceral, agonizing choice between immediate survival and the erosion of self, transforming a tactical decision into a moment of profound existential dread and desperate sacrifice. It ensures that the 'grief of self-loss' is not just narrative but a tangible, painful gameplay cost, making each encounter with the Silence a personal battle against oblivion.
